prompt:
Summarize this external code review in 1-3 concise sentences. Focus on WHAT the reviewer wants changed, not boilerplate. Strip tool share links, HTML tags, promotional text.

## Review Feedback
Hey - I've left some high level feedback:

- The PSS violation check in Step 5 depends on the exact message `violates PodSecurity "restricted:latest"`, which may change across Kubernetes versions; consider matching on a more stable substring (e.g. `violates PodSecurity` plus profile/version checks separately) to avoid brittle failures on cluster upgrades.
- The manual fernet rotation logic assumes the Job name `keystone-pss-restricted-manual-rotate` does not exist; to make reruns and partial-cleanup scenarios more robust, consider deleting any existing Job with that name before creation or using `--generate-name` to create a unique name per run.
